lines.note: New: Outer turrets in the top and middle lanes now have Lane Swap Detector.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Lane Swap Detector: If two or more enemy champions, excluding the one who possesses a Jungle item, are detected within this lane and its immediately surrounding area, activates the following effects. Detection begins at 1:30 and ends at 3:30 game time. If no player on the enemy team has equipped a Jungle item, the rule is entirely disabled against that team; if two or more players on a team have equipped a Jungle item, all players who own a Jungle item are invariably included in the rule.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Lane Swap Detected (Middle Lane): This turret has gained 95% damage reduction from all sources. Its attacks against minions deal 1000% damage. Detected enemies are debuffed, causing them to earn and bounty. The is granted a buff, causing them to be attributed kill score and 100% of the bounty from champions and minions killed by the origin turret or the lane's minions—regardless of range, combat or death status, or the kill attribution timer from damage. These effects will linger for 6 seconds after leaving the detection area.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Lane Swap Detected (Top Lane): This turret has gained 95% damage reduction from all sources. Its attacks against champions and minions deal 1000% damage. Detected enemies are debuffed, causing them to earn and bounty. The is granted a buff, causing them to gain 50% damage reduction within cr 600 units of the origin turret and be attributed kill score and 100% of the bounty from champions and minions killed by the origin turret or the lane's minions—regardless of range, combat or death status, or the kill attribution timer from damage. These effects will linger for 20 seconds after leaving the detection area.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Players approaching the detection area or are within it will trigger a flashing text on their champion every two seconds stating "Lane swap detected! Please leave the area!". While under the detection's effects, the detected champions gain a debuff indicating they are incurring the Lane Swap Detector penalty and the defending champion gains a buff indicating they have gained its bonuses; these are not visible to enemies. Champions incurring the penalty will also show a prominent mark next to them; this is visible to both teams.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Champions slain by the turret during the detection's effects will award a kill point to the buffed ally, as normal. Enemies are not executed nor announced as such.
